title: Prove exact ten-term tariffs for independent radical fanout triples
body:
The non-zero-sum demand `(e,h,e+h+z)` over `F2[e,h,z]/(e,h,z)^2` was explicitly left open in #5259. This five-file package determines its exact receiving-row tariff for every six strictly positive prices, with matching constructions and a proof covering arbitrary finite interleavings.

For distinct i,j,k, the optimum is the minimum of the ten terms

```text
D      = mu_0 + mu_1 + mu_2
T_i    = 2mu_i + 2c_j + 2c_k                       (3 terms)
R_ij;k = 2mu_i + mu_j + 2c_k                      (6 terms)
```

All ten terms have strict positive-price witnesses. The proof extends to any commutative unital local ring whose three demand classes in m/m^2 are linearly independent over R/m. A two-insertion solution must use two unit coefficients; if they enter different rows, incoming dirt restoration forces a bill strictly above min(T_i,T_j). This is a complete price envelope, not a complete componentwise Pareto-frontier classification.

Only `research/r16-radical-triple-fanout/` is added. The contribution head is `4e08457f4d0b69c00a6ca62eca81c8d0a55f3e60`, directly based on canonical main `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`. Entry and completion checks found no new same-scope result or active claim in the documented coverage. The original card and the donor-assigned scope change are retained in TASK.json. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

Validation on CPython 3.12.13/macOS x86_64:

- All 22,152 applicable triples across rings of orders 16, 81 and 64; 221,520 constructions; 1,772,160 formal forward/inverse column evaluations. The order-64 fixture has m^2 != 0.
- All 65,536 scalar dirty/source inputs for each requested-ring construction, in both directions: 1,310,720 evaluations. Ten strict exposures and eleven hypothesis/sign/dirty-input controls pass.
- Four separate full-state bidirectional Dijkstra queries allow all 135 nonzero-coefficient gates. Optima 3, 6, 6 and 23/12 agree; 8,465 entries are settled. Exploratory searches that were interrupted or hit a guard are disclosed and not counted as certificates.
- Warning-strict isolated normal and optimized registered replay, metadata/source pins, staged whitespace, three optimized semantic mutations and exact committed-byte checks pass.
- Official five-file export integrity passes. Its optimized replay with a read-only filesystem tree and no Git on PATH also passes with all payload bytes unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r16-radical-triple-fanout
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/r16-radical-triple-fanout
```

Finite checks corroborate the written theorem; they are not independent human or proof-kernel review. Hosted CI is pending at publication. The optional full-history preflight is not claimed in this shallow checkout; every source pin resolves at the direct parent. Directed-edge prices, dependent demand classes, nonlocal rings, helper rows, physical coefficient/source/routing/precision/stock costs and supplier admission remain outside scope. No selected-operator, Lean, Docker or historical suite was run.

Prepared by lee-phys with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Retain #5259/#5514 interpreter/search credit, Ali Romman #5266/#5310 source-feasibility work, lee-phys #5139/#5163, Nick Petalas #5208/#4916, Krzysztof Wojt #5045, Ross Richardson #3063/#3121 and the retained lineage.
